items.text: The page titles are different. A uses a WordPress-style 'Page - Site' title, while B uses the brand name followed by its tagline.
items.evidence: A title: 'Ridetech Home - Ridetech'; B title: 'Ridetech | Performance Suspension Specialist'

items.text: The lang attributes differ: A uses a regional code and B uses a bare language code.
items.evidence: A lang 'en-US'; B lang 'en'

items.text: B marks up the news post titles as h3 headings. A does not include news titles in its heading outline.
items.evidence: B outline: h3 'Salt Lake City GoodGuys Car show...' and h3 'Great Times at the C-10 Nationals...'; absent in A outline

items.text: Heading text casing differs. B's headings are uppercase in the source, while A uses title case.
items.evidence: A 'Shop by Vehicle', 'Latest News'; B 'SHOP BY VEHICLE', 'LATEST NEWS', 'RIDETECH.COM'

items.text: A uses the Open Sans font family. B uses Helvetica Neue for body text and Impact for display headings.
items.evidence: A fonts: Open Sans 1048, Lucida Grande 163, fl-icons 20; B fonts: Helvetica Neue 333, Impact 9

items.text: A centers its section headings ('Shop by Vehicle', 'Shop by Product'). B left-aligns them and adds a short red underline bar.
items.evidence: A_slice_00 centered gray headings; B_slice_00/02 left-aligned headings with red rule beneath

items.text: The two sides use slightly different reds.
A's body background is transparent with light-gray containers. B sets an explicit white body background and uses #f4f4f4 for alternating section bands.
The primary buttons differ. A's is a red pill reading 'GET A FREE CATALOG', while B's detected primary button is a transparent, square 'Menu' button.
items.evidence: A primary_button radius 99px bg rgb(220,31,38); B primary_button 'Menu' bg transparent radius 0px

items.text: B uses CSS Grid. A relies only on flexbox.
items.evidence: B display_grid 7, display_flex 18; A display_grid 0, display_flex 128

items.text: B adds a black utility bar above the header with a phone number and links (Sign Up for News, Get a FREE Catalog, Login/Register).
items.evidence: B_slice_00 top bar '☎ 812.481.4787 ... Login / Register'

items.text: A has a dark full-width nav bar with ten items under the logo and search row. B puts four nav items inline with the logo, search and cart in a single white header row.
items.evidence: A_slice_00 dark bar PRODUCTS…CAREERS; B_slice_00 'PRODUCTS APPLICATIONS NEWS TECH' beside logo

items.text: A's hero is a full-width slider showing one slide at a time, with off-screen slides stacked horizontally. B shows four banners side by side, each cropped to a quarter of the width.
items.evidence: A images at x=-1200/0/1200 w1440 h338 with overlaps; B four images w360 h240 at x 0/360/720/1080, cropped text visible

items.text: The Free Shipping band differs. A shows only 'FREE SHIPPING' in a slim red strip. B uses a taller red band with a subline about $100 continental U.S. shipping.
items.evidence: A_slice_00 thin red bar; B_slice_00 'FREE GROUND SHIPPING TO THE CONTINENTAL U.S. FOR ORDERS OF $100 OR MORE'

items.text: The vehicle categories render differently. A shows unboxed silhouettes with large spaced gray labels. B puts each vehicle in a bordered card with a red divider and smaller bold black labels.
items.evidence: A_slice_00 vs B_slice_00 shop-by-vehicle row

items.text: A's product tiles are 188px images with no container. B's tiles are 275px-wide bordered cards with a red rule above the label.
items.evidence: A product img rect w188 h188; B w275 h206; B_slice_01 bordered cards

items.text: A shows images for all 22 product categories. B shows images for only the first 11 categories; the remaining cards (LevelTow through Bushings) are gray text-only boxes.
items.evidence: B images list ends at products-link-parallel-web; B_slice_01 text-only cards 'TRU TURN', 'APPAREL', etc.

items.text: Image alt text differs. A gives the product images descriptive alts. B leaves them empty but gives its hero images descriptive alts.
items.evidence: A alt 'Shock Absorbers', 'Tubular Control Arms'; B product alts ''; B hero alt '2007–2013 GM Silverado suspension'

items.text: A shows the vehicle silhouettes as images or SVGs larger than B's. B's silhouettes are 216x121 PNG images.
items.evidence: B images muscle-car.png etc. rect 216x121; A_slice_00 larger silhouettes spanning ≈240px

items.text: The free catalog promo differs. A embeds it in the sidebar as a catalog image with a small red pill 'REQUEST A CATALOG' button. B gives it a two-column section with a book image, a large red Impact 'Free', and a square red button.
items.evidence: A_slice_01 sidebar catalog; B_slice_01 'Free PRODUCT CATALOG' + 'REQUEST A CATALOG' + catalog image 360x288

items.text: A shows a '1,000,001 mile warranty' banner image. B replaces it with a red text link reading '1,000,001 Mile Warranty →'.
items.evidence: A hp-ad-1.jpg alt 'shock warranty' 410x178; B_slice_01 text link

items.text: A's Latest News items have photo thumbnails, centered small bold titles, and a full-width red 'VIEW ALL NEWS' button. B's news cards are text-only with a red left border, and B uses a red 'View all news →' text link.
items.evidence: A_slice_01/02 photo34 and IMG_2627 images 450x253; B_slice_02 bordered text cards

items.text: A places the newsletter sign-up as a stacked form in the sidebar with a small red button. B gives it a full-width 'GET CONNECTED' section with three inline fields and a SIGN UP button.
items.evidence: A_slice_00/01 sidebar form; B_slice_02 horizontal form

items.text: Both pages have a brand-blurb band. A sets 'ridetech.com' in lowercase white Open Sans with a white subtitle. B uses an uppercase Impact 'RIDETECH.COM', a red underline, and a pink-red letterspaced subtitle.
items.evidence: A_slice_02 vs B_slice_02 brand band

items.text: A puts the 'Let us know' prompt and social links on a separate red bar with circular icons. B puts them inside the photo band as outlined text buttons (Facebook, Instagram, Email, Call, YouTube).
items.evidence: A_slice_02 red bar with circular icons; B_slice_02 bordered text buttons

items.text: A's footer has a dark gradient background, a red 'FREE CATALOG' image, and a lighter gray copyright strip with payment icons. B's footer is flat near-black with a hairline divider and a 'Back to top ↑' link.
items.evidence: A_slice_02/03 gradient, VISA/MasterCard/Discover/AmEx/PayPal icons; B_slice_03 flat dark, 'Back to top ↑'

items.text: The page heights differ slightly, with B the taller of the two.
items.evidence: A page_height 4129; B 4222 (both 1440 wide)

items.text: A's main content runs nearly edge to edge from x≈15. B's content sits in a centered container from x≈136 to 1304.
items.evidence: A logo x15, products x15; B logo x136, products x137

items.text: Neither page uses Tailwind-style classes. A has a small fraction of them and B has none.
items.evidence: A tailwind_like_fraction 0.042; B 0

items.text: A's DOM is large and WordPress/Flatsome-style. B's is small and hand-built.
items.evidence: A: 462 divs, 32 scripts, 29 style tags, 45 noscript, 189 anchors. B: 25 divs, 1 script, 0 style tags, 115 anchors

items.text: A uses many utility/plugin classes and many inline style attributes. B uses a small, hand-named class set and almost no inline styles.
items.evidence: A: 2072 class uses, 504 unique, 97 inline style attrs. B: 83 class uses, 29 unique, 4 inline style attrs

items.text: B has a dedicated <nav> element and six <section> elements. A has zero <nav> and only two <section> elements, so its menu is built from divs and lists.
items.evidence: semantic: A nav 0, section 2; B nav 1, section 6

items.text: A's palette uses blue-gray slate and light blue-gray neutrals (rgb(58,72,86), rgb(243,245,247), link color rgb(83,104,130)). B's palette is neutral black/white/gray (20,20,20; 244,244,244).
A uses a two-column layout with a right sidebar. The sidebar stacks a Get Connected signup form, free-shipping and warranty ad images, and news cards. B is single-column, full-width stacked sections.
items.evidence: A images at x≈975–1425 (shock warranty ad, photo34, IMG_2627); B has no sidebar images; B display_grid 7

items.text: B includes the Salt Lake City GoodGuys news item as a heading, while A's visible sidebar shows only its excerpt tail.
items.evidence: B h3 'Salt Lake City GoodGuys Car show Info & Photo Gallery.'

items.text: B's corners are square with only slight rounding. A's most elements are also square, but it has a handful of large-radius and pill elements (buttons, cart, icons).
items.evidence: border_radius_buckets A: 16_plus 5, pill 17; B: bucket_0 304, bucket_1_7 38, nothing above

items.text: Both use similar footer and contact copy (address 350 S. St. Charles St, Jasper, Indiana; Mon–Fri hours; copyright 2021). A has 3 exclamation marks and B 3, so the copy is largely carried over.
items.evidence: text_stats exclamations 3/3; both show '© 2021 Ridetech'

features.statement: Page title pairs the brand name with a short descriptive tagline, separated by a pipe.
Section headings are set in uppercase text.
Typography pairs a Helvetica Neue body font with Impact for condensed display headings.
Section headings are left-aligned with a short red accent underline bar beneath them.
Palette is neutral black, white and light gray, with a single saturated red accent.
Explicit white page background with alternating light-gray (#f4f4f4) section bands.
Primary buttons and calls to action are square-cornered, with no pill shapes.
Layout uses CSS Grid for card and banner arrangements.
A black utility bar above the header holds phone number and account or promo links.
Header is a single white row with logo, a few inline nav items, search and cart.
Hero shows several banners side by side as a cropped multi-panel strip rather than a slider.
Promo band is a tall red strip with a bold headline and explanatory subline.
Categories appear as bordered cards with a red divider rule and small bold uppercase labels.
Some cards are text-only gray boxes without images, so card imagery is inconsistent.
Promo and warranty banners are replaced by text links with arrow glyphs instead of images.
News items are text-only cards with a red left border and no thumbnails.
Newsletter signup is a full-width section with inline horizontal fields and a single submit button.
Social and contact links appear as outlined, bordered text buttons over a photo band.
Footer is flat near-black with a hairline divider and a 'Back to top ↑' link.
Content sits in a centered fixed-width container with generous side margins.
Single-column layout of full-width stacked sections with no sidebar.
Markup is small and hand-built, with few divs, one script, few classes and almost no inline styles.
Uses semantic nav and section elements, and news titles as h3 headings.
Corners are square or only slightly rounded, with no large radii.
